newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals ranged on low demand, poor arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals ranged on low demand, poor arrivals.

text.p: Base metals held steady in a narrow trading range on the local market on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Demand from industrial consumers remained low but limited arrivals as well as reports of narrow movement in the world market kept local market quiet," a dealer said.
"Volume was poor ahead of Diwali and will pickup after Diwali only," one broker said. "The market is likely to move in a narrow range ahead of Diwali."
Ready copper was steady at 11,550 rupees per quintal so did zinc at 6,250 rupees and lead at 4,650 rupees per quintal amid thin activity. Offerings by state agencies were also low.
Nickel was available at the previous level of 37,200 rupees per quintal and tin at 34,900 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was steady at 7,200 rupees per quintal in nominal trade.
